review_notes: I read all 362 lines of the target file and searched the Mathlib sources for pre-existing versions of each concept it introduces. (1) `contractLeft`/`contractRight` (lines 82, 111): the only other declarations with these names are `LinearMap.contractLeft` and `LinearMap.contractRight` in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Contraction.lean, which are the tensor pairings `Module.Dual R M ⊗[R] M →ₗ[R] R` and `M ⊗[R] Module.Dual R M →ₗ[R] R` (lines 51 and 56) — different domains, codomains and meaning, so not the same concept. The exterior-algebra folder defines no contraction or interior product (only `ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₗ[R] M`, a left inverse of `ι` with no dual parameter), and a global search for `def …contract…` / `def …interior…` turned up nothing else relevant. (2) `contractRight` is by design the `reverse`-conjugate of `contractLeft` (line 112, `contractRight_eq` is `rfl`); the rubric explicitly protects named wrappers and chosen orientations built by composition, so I did not report it. (3) `changeFormAux`/`changeForm`/`changeFormEquiv` (lines 222–342): Mathlib's only other maps between Clifford algebras are `CliffordAlgebra.map` (Basic.lean:325, needs an isometry `Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂`) and `CliffordAlgebra.equivOfIsometry` (Basic.lean:379); `changeForm` works under the incomparable hypothesis that `Q' - Q` is the diagonal of a bilinear form and is only linear, so it is not a competing version. (4) `equivExterior` (line 351): no other `CliffordAlgebra Q ≃ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M` exists; the only user, Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Inversion.lean:64, depends on it, so it is not an independent replacement. (5) The `Nontrivial (CliffordAlgebra Q)` instance (lines 359–360) is the only `Nontrivial` instance for `CliffordAlgebra` in Mathlib; the `Nontrivial (ExteriorAlgebra R M)` instance (ExteriorAlgebra/Basic.lean:421) covers only the definitionally special case `Q = 0` and hence is not a substitute for general `Q`. I also considered and rejected two near-misses: the local `⌊`/`⌋` infix (lines 118–120, 216–218) is notation that happens to share glyphs with floor notation, not a competing definition, and `contractLeftAux` (line 62) versus `changeFormAux` (line 222) are genuinely different auxiliary fold-steps (pair-accumulator contraction versus a single-accumulator derivation step), not two versions of one concept. Items I noticed but which fall outside this rubric: the `#adaptation_note` plus `attribute [nolint simpNF] equivExterior.eq_1` (lines 354–356), the TODO at lines 211–213, the duplicated `haveI v_mul := …` local instance in both auxiliaries, and the redundant `toFun := changeForm h` field in `changeFormEquiv` (line 330). Uncertainty: I could not run Lean, so the statement that `ExteriorAlgebra R M` is definitionally `CliffordAlgebra (0 : QuadraticForm R M)` is based on the `abbrev` at ExteriorAlgebra/Basic.lean:60–61 and its docstring at line 46.
